name: Leaderboard
badge: shared web component — canvas and audience
summary: The ranked score list for the slide canvas and the audience phone, one look: rank chip, name, score, an optional bar behind the name, a trophy on first place, and the participant's own row pinned with a You tag.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-leaderboard> — for the presenter canvas and the audience phone alike. It draws the list only; place it in a deck container or modal. Themed from the deck: call applyCanvasDeck (canvas) or applyDeck (audience) once, and it reads --aha-deck-* tokens only. Rows are measured to the element's height, so give it a height and it shows as many rows as fit, then an "and N more" line.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, so the canvas and the phone render identically. Set `entries` as a JSON attribute or a property.

spec.label: Row
spec.value: stage 48px tall, 12px gap; phone 40px tall, 8px gap. A rank chip, the name track (radius 8) and the score at the end

spec.label: Rank chip
spec.value: circle 32 (stage) / 24 (phone). Ranks 1 to 3 are filled with the deck accent and its ink; the rest are an outlined chip. Rank 1 shows the system-trophy glyph (the numeral stays for screen readers). No gold, silver or bronze: the top three read by fill, not hue

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: behind the name, width = score / top score, in the deck accent. The name is drawn twice and the on-fill copy is clipped to the bar, so the ink flips exactly at the bar's edge. bar="false" removes it

spec.label: Avatar slot
spec.value: a fixed 28 / 24px slot for an emoji or image, so names and scores align whatever the glyph width

spec.label: Score
spec.value: semibold, tabular, right-aligned in a column sized to the widest score, so the column aligns

spec.label: Own row
spec.value: the row for `me` carries a You tag and a stronger outline. Outside the shown rows it is pinned below the "and N more" line

spec.label: Fit
spec.value: rows are measured to the element's height; past that an "and N more" line. No fixed cap unless `limit` is set

spec.label: Teams
spec.value: an entry with `members` shows a member count and its bar takes the deck palette fill and ink pair (--aha-deck-palette-<n> / -ink), falling back to the accent where the deck wrote no palette

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: rows slide to their new rank (FLIP, --aha-motion-viz-reorder), the bar and ink clip grow together and the score counts up; none under prefers-reduced-motion

spec.label: Empty and loading
spec.value: one line "No scores yet"; five skeleton rows while `loading`

props.name: entries
props.desc: The scores, in any order. Also the `entries` property. `avatar` is an emoji or an image URL; `members` makes the row a team

props.name: me
props.desc: The participant's entry id: its row gets the You tag and is pinned when it is outside the shown rows

props.name: bar
props.desc: bar="false" removes the bar behind the name

props.name: trophy
props.desc: trophy="false" drops the trophy on rank 1 (a game still running)

props.name: size
props.desc: One look at two scales: stage for the presenter canvas, phone for the audience

props.name: limit
props.desc: Optional cap on ranked rows; by default only the height limits them

props.name: palette-size
props.desc: How many deck palette colours team rows cycle through

props.name: you-label
props.desc: The tag on the participant's own row

props.name: more-label
props.desc: The line after the last shown row

props.name: members-label
props.desc: The member count on a team row

props.name: rank-label
props.desc: Announced politely when the participant's own rank changes

props.name: ink / accent
props.desc: Deck ink and accent for this element only; normally inherited from applyCanvasDeck or applyDeck

whenToUse.when: any ranked list of participants or teams by score, on the canvas or the phone
results of a question, not a ranking of people

opinion.note: Never hand-build a leaderboard row. Place the element in a deck container or modal (--aha-deck-container-*, --aha-deck-modal-*) and give it a height.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the stage example with no deck applied (DS defaults).

selfCheck.label: top three filled with the deck accent, trophy on first, no status hue

highlights: One rank chip, name, score row on the canvas and the phone
Optional bar with an ink flip at the bar's edge
Trophy on first place, ties share a rank, own row pinned with a You tag
Rows fit the element's height; rank changes slide and scores count up

composedOf.note: canvas only: applyCanvasDeck writes it, applyDeck does not, so team bars on the phone fall back to the deck accent
audience palette pairs; teams on the phone share the accent until applyDeck takes a palette

a11y.role: an ordered list named by `label`; each row reads rank, name, score and the You tag; the clipped copy of the name is aria-hidden
a11y.note: A polite live region announces the participant's own new rank. Motion is off under prefers-reduced-motion.
